flame.Name: Flame
flame.Description: Fire-lit sources — candles, torches, hearths, and lava.

atmosphere.Name: Atmosphere
atmosphere.Description: Mostly dim-only sources that colour a space rather than light it.

magic.Name: Magic
magic.Description: Arcane and divine light, plus two darkness sources.

presetCandle.Name: Candle
presetCandle.Description: A small, warm flame with a quick low flicker that fades out close to the source. Suits bedside tables, shrines, and clusters of candles — place one light for a whole candelabra.

presetTorch.Name: Torch
presetTorch.Description: The classic wall-sconce or handheld torch: strong warm light with a lively flicker.

presetLantern.Name: Lantern
presetLantern.Description: Warm, steady glow with only a gentle flicker — a hooded lantern by a door, or hung outside an inn.

presetBullseye.Name: Bullseye Lantern (cone)
presetBullseye.Description: A shuttered lantern that throws a focused 60° beam.

presetCampfire.Name: Campfire
presetCampfire.Description: A larger, heavier flame animation with deep orange tones. Campfires, braziers, and open cooking fires.

presetChimney.Name: Chimney (cone)
presetChimney.Description: A fire set into a wall: a 180° spill that lights the room and nothing behind it, deeper and calmer than an open flame. The cone is built in rather than left to wall occlusion, because the light sits inside the wall footprint where walls would clip it.

presetMagical.Name: Magical Glow
presetMagical.Description: A soft violet pulse for enchanted crystals, runes, and ambient arcane light.

presetMoonlight.Name: Moonlight
presetMoonlight.Description: Pale, steady blue-white light with no animation. Windows at night, moonlit clearings, and skylights.

presetFog.Name: Fog Bank
presetFog.Description: Grey swirling fog rather than a lamp — low luminosity so it reads as atmosphere. Marshes, graveyards, and sewer haze. The swirl shows from moderate scene darkness up; in full daylight it's only a pale haze.

presetFey.Name: Fey Lights
presetFey.Description: Soft pink shimmer using the fairy animation. Feywild groves, pixie swarms, and enchanted gardens.

presetGhostly.Name: Ghostly
presetGhostly.Description: Sickly green ghost-light flicker. Haunted halls, spectral apparitions, and cursed shrines.

presetStarlight.Name: Starlight
presetStarlight.Description: A single cold star-glint with faint rays and no bright core. Where Moonlight holds steady, this one twinkles.

presetBioluminescence.Name: Bioluminescence
presetBioluminescence.Description: A slow cyan-green glow that swells and fades, with no bright core. Fungus groves and glowing moss in deep caves.

presetUnderwater.Name: Underwater
presetUnderwater.Description: Sea-blue light in slow rings that ripple outward. Flooded rooms, sea caves, and sunken ruins.

presetLava.Name: Lava Glow
presetLava.Description: Deep red-orange glow with a slow, heavy flame roil. Lava pools, forge hearts, and embers.

presetDivine.Name: Divine Radiance
presetDivine.Description: Warm golden sunburst pulse. Altars, holy auras, and consecrated ground.

presetArcaneWard.Name: Arcane Ward
presetArcaneWard.Description: Cool blue light with a hexagonal shield pattern, for protective circles and warded doors.

presetPortal.Name: Portal
presetPortal.Description: Violet light spiralling inward. Gates, rifts, and tears into other planes.

presetStorm.Name: Storm
presetStorm.Description: Blue-white veins of crackling energy. Charged crystals and lightning traps.

presetDarkness.Name: Magical Darkness (darkness source)
presetDarkness.Description: A darkness source, not a light: it carves an area of magical gloom out of existing illumination. Use for darkness spells and cursed zones.

presetSmoke.Name: Smoke Cloud (darkness source)
presetSmoke.Description: A darkness source: a grey haze of thick smoke that dims everything inside it. Smoke bombs, burning buildings, or a vent pouring out fumes.

Back.Title: Back to Preset Groups
Back.Hint: Collapse this group and return to the {groups} buttons.

Visibility.Name: Configure Presets
Visibility.Hint: Choose which presets appear on the lighting toolbar. Lights you've already placed are not affected, and a group with no presets left disappears.

Toolclip.AimValue: the cone points the way you drag; to turn a placed light, select it and Shift + scroll over it
Toolclip.RadiusDimOnly: dim only — no bright core; your drag sets the dim radius
Toolclip.RadiusHalf: set by your drag distance; bright is half the dim radius
Toolclip.RadiusPercent: set by your drag distance; bright is {percent}% of the dim radius
Toolclip.PresetHint: Click to make this the default for new lights, then drag on the canvas to place one.
Toolclip.GroupHint: Click to open this group. The pip marks the group holding your active preset.
